messages:
elyse: heads-up — seeing a spike of 403s on GPU deploys after the RBAC policy refactor landed last night. almost all are from ephemeral job namespaces.
sam: oi, any request IDs or logs? can you paste one 403 stack?
elyse: deploy-bot showed this in the CICD channel but here are the last lines from k8s-events: 
```
Normal  Warning  FailedCreate  pod/gpu-worker-xyz  Error creating: pods "gpu-worker-xyz" is forbidden: error looking up service account default: serviceaccount "default" not found
```
lorenzo: hmm that smells like a race: rolebinding created before serviceaccount is projected into the ns -> binding lands to a non-existent SA name and later SA gets a different UID so access denied. we changed RoleBinding creation ordering in the operator.
maria: did the refactor change subjects order or apply strategy? iirc we switched to server-side apply for RoleBindings which reorders subjects sometimes.
elyse: yes — operator now does SSO + server-side-apply for roles. suspect binding got created with an ephemeral SA name placeholder.
deploy-bot: [ALERT] 2176543210 - deployment/gpu-runner failed: 403 Forbidden (rolebinding: subjects mismatch) :thumbsdown:
audit-bot: Query hit: 27 similar failed create events in the last 30m. top offenders: ci-gpu-operator, job-runner. KMS decrypt errors = 3 entries (token unwrap failures)
sam: KMS decrypt errors could mean serviceaccount tokens were rotated or the KMS key policy denies decrypt to the new binder SA. did we change KMS IAM in the same PR?
lorenzo: no KMS IAM changes in the PR. but operator does a short-lived SA token exchange path that hits KMS unwrap. if SA UID differs, token doesn't match envelope metadata -> unwrap fails.
maria: immediate mitigation: reapply authoritative RoleBindings in affected namespaces with explicit subject UIDs (avoid SSA) and patch operator to wait for SA creation before binding.
elyse: can we patch now? i can run a targeted rebind for the gpu-* namespaces. sample command: 
```
# list affected namespaces
kubectl get ns | grep gpu-
# rebind to current SA (run per-namespace)
kubectl get sa default -n gpu-123 -o yaml | yq '.metadata.uid'
kubectl patch rolebinding gpu-operator-bind -n gpu-123 --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/subjects/0/uid","value":"<CURRENT-SA-UID>"}]'
```
sam: short-term +1. for a small blast radius do a canary rebind on 2 namespaces then monitor. also spin a short-lived test job.
lorenzo: i'll open a minimal hotfix PR to change operator to: (1) watch SA creation and block until exists, (2) use server-side apply with force=false to preserve subject ordering, (3) emit a specific audit event when SA UID mismatch detected.
elyse: audit query we should run to enumerate impacted service accounts: 
```
# cloud logs (replace project/idx)
gcloud logging read 'resource.type=k8s_container AND severity>=ERROR AND jsonPayload.message: "serviceaccount"' --limit 100 --project=infra-ops | grep -i gpu
```
audit-bot: Saved query -> "rbac-rolebinding-uid-mismatch". tagged incidents: gpu-deploy-403, rbac-ordering.
maria: can we also confirm KMS key policy to be safe? run an IAM check: 
```
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy KEY_NAME --location=global --keyring=redwood-keys
```
lorenzo: good call. i'll validate policies but low chance KMS changed. root cause is ordering + SSA.
elyse: thanks — i'll do the canary rebind now and post back results. if successful we roll remaining namespaces over the next hour.
sam: ping me when the first canary finishes.
maria: filing postmortem checklist item: avoid SSA ordering assumptions, add unit test for subject UID preservation, add operator e2e that simulates delayed SA creation.
elyse: canary done — gpu-7 and gpu-11 now OK. no more 403s for those deploys. rolling rest in 3 batches.
sam: nice. assign a follow-up PR to security/owner for RBAC refactor rollback vs fix? what do we prefer?
lorenzo: we'll patch the operator (small change) + add e2e; no rollback needed. i'll open the PR and tag you @sam for review.
elyse: created issue #4532 with mitigation steps, timeline, and audit log pointers. assigning owners. :white_check_mark:
maria: great job triaging. once PR merges let's run a full audit query for the last 24h and upload to the compliance folder.
elyse: will do. closing thread after roll completes. thanks team. :rocket:
